summary: Test Processed Meat Product contains Sodium Nitrite requiring caution. Moderate consumption recommended. [1][2]

high_risk.name: Sodium Nitrite
high_risk.micro_report: Forms nitrosamines (carcinogens) upon reaction with amines during processing or digestion. Nitrosamines damage DNA, increasing cancer risk, particularly colorectal cancer. (Source: IARC Monographs, WHO).

moderate_risk.name: Salt (Sodium Chloride)
moderate_risk.micro_report: High sodium intake links to hypertension, increasing stroke and heart disease risk. Moderation is key; recommended daily intake is <2300mg. (Source: American Heart Association)

moderate_risk.name: Monosodium Glutamate (MSG)
moderate_risk.micro_report: Can trigger headaches and other symptoms in sensitive individuals (MSG symptom complex). Most tolerate it well, but moderation is advised for susceptible people. (Source: FDA)

moderate_risk.name: BHA (Butylated Hydroxyanisole)
moderate_risk.micro_report: A preservative with potential endocrine-disrupting effects and links to some cancers in animal studies. Human data is less conclusive, but moderation is a prudent approach. (Source: EFSA)

moderate_risk.name: Sodium Phosphate
moderate_risk.micro_report: High intake can contribute to mineral imbalances and kidney problems, especially in individuals with pre-existing conditions. Moderation is advised. (Source: National Institutes of Health)
